reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are more than most TikTok supplements give me, and the money-back guarantee with nothing to send back lowers the risk. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one, but not two until I know it works.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I don't want to pay for 30 days of something I forget on the counter and can't tell is doing anything.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was $29.99 with no coupon or flash deal, I'd wait for a sale instead.
